title: Rewrite Systems for Natural, Integral, and Rational Arithmetic
notes: RTA 1997, LNCS 1232, pp. 98-112. Direct prior art: integers use balanced-ternary postfix digit append with digits -1,0,1 and semantics x :_t a = 3x+a. The arithmetic TRS is terminating and confluent modulo associativity and commutativity of addition and multiplication. This predates the repository's arithmetic-rewriting work; I_a is the same digit-append map. The repository's narrower comparison concerns an explicit destructor D, an open one-hole unary grammar, semantic injectivity of its irreducibles, and the D-locality obstruction.
